Name: Fashionable Mirrors
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/dfJ865T.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Fashionable Mirrors is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12831]Dynamic Reflections[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] pack which adds a small of amount of functional mirror furniture. These furniture have reflective surfaces and can be right-clicked to open Fashion Sense's customization menu.


[img]https://imgur.com/Z1gPWFR.gif[/img]


[img]https://imgur.com/auC2p9O.png[/img]
[b][size=5]Getting the Mirrors[/size][/b]
[size=3]The mirrors can be found in the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Furniture_Catalogue]Furniture Catalog[/url].[/size][/size][size=3]

[b][size=5]Using the Mirror[/size][/b]
[size=3]To use the mirror and open Fashion Sense's UI, simply approach and right click it.[/size]
[/size]

Downloads.Description:
Supports Stardew Valley v1.6+.


Requires Fashion Sense, Content Patcher and Dynamic Reflections.
